newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO Fatah gears up for anti-settlement protest.
newsitem.headline: PLO Fatah gears up for anti-settlement protest.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's Fatah movement is calling for demonstrations to protest against Israel's construction of housing for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem, Fatah leaders said on Tuesday.

The leaders, meeting in the West Bank town of Beit Sahour on Sunday, called Israel's building of 6,500 apartments "an act of terrorism" and urged followers to prepare to "confront settlements and settlers by all legitimate means."

"Our objective is to raise our voice to the world against settlement activity. But we are not calling for violence," Mahmoud Jasser, a Fatah spokesman in the West Bank district of Ramallah, told Reuters.

The Fatah meeting called for blocking roads used by Jewish settlers in the West Bank and for mass marches. It urged Arafat's Palestinian Authority to suspend peace talks and sever all contacts with Israel.
Jasser said Fatah had been under public pressure to take the lead in confronting Israeli settlement plans.
"We consider Israel's building a massacre against Jerusalem and we must try to defend the city," he said.
Scores of Palestinians have been injured by rubber bullets and teargas fired by Israeli soldiers in West Bank clashes.
Palestinians envisage making a future capital of East Jerusalem, which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war and annexed, declaring it part of the Jewish state's "eternal, indivisible" capital.
